This plugin **only fills the gaps the official bui"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ld leaves** instead of duplicating them:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Scenario | Owner |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| `@` completion for files/folders/sessions in the composer | **official** (`dsh-file-reference` + `"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ui-reference`) |
| Markdown file links in messages (`x`, with `#L24`) | **official** (opens in the r"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ight sidebar) — this plugin **skips anything inside `<a>`**, so nothing is decorated twice |

| **Bare paths in backticks** in message text (`` `~/x/y.md"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"` ``, which the official renderer ignores) | **this plugin**: click to open with the system default "},{"id":"p15s7","text":"app |
| The folder icon next to a bare path (reveal in file manager) and the "📎 mentioned files" rai"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"l at the end of a reply | **this plugin** (no official counterpart) |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- DSH web >= 0.1.0-rc.6 (run with `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`)
- **Version compatibility** (best effo"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"rt — the settings card uses dual-field `key`+`id` registration to satisfy both rc.6 (`id`) and rc.7+"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" (`key`); verified locally on rc.6/rc.8/0.1.1-rc.2/0.1.2-alpha.2/0.1.5-rc.1 (clickable paths + "ment"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ioned files" panel), **not guaranteed on every DSH version**):
- DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 and newer (incl. 0.1"},{"id":"p17s5","text":".1-rc.1/rc.2 and 0.1.2): try `main` (default).
- **DSH 0.1.5-rc.1: load-verified** (the plugin is in"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" the client bundle and `/api/file-mentions/check` responds); UI interactions were not eyeballed item"},{"id":"p17s7","text":" by item. ⚠️ 0.1.5 ships a **narrow** built-in "clickable inline-code paths in the closing reply" (o"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"nly files written via `write`/`edit`/`present` in that turn — see `dsh-client-ui-deliverables`), whi"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"ch partially overlaps; plain-text/bare paths, cross-turn and historical messages are still handled o"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"nly by this plugin.
- Conservative fallbacks (the last pre-0.1.1 build): DSH 0.1.0-rc.7/rc.8 → `v1.0"},{"id":"p17s11","text":".8` (`dsh plugin add github:a903067276-rgb/dsh-file-mentions#v1.0.8`); DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 → frozen `rc6-"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"compat` tag (no maintenance).
- Pure Node stdlib implementation — peer dependencies (`@deepseek-ai/d"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"sh-settings`,
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`) are provided by the host
- Opening files uses the system d"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"efault app / file manager (per-platform command branching)
- ✅ **DSH 0.1.7 and later — use this rele"},{"id":"p17s15","text":"ase (`v1.2.2`)**: it declares `peerDependencies: {"@deepseek-ai/dsh": "^0.1.7-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1"}`"},{"id":"p17s16","text":", so a mismatched host refuses to load it with an explicit reason instead of failing quietly. Settin"},{"id":"p17s17","text":"gs move to the 0.1.7 model (plugin `Config`, live-editable `.volatile()` fields), so changes apply w"},{"id":"p17s18","text":"ithout a restart.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Host** (`lib/index.js`): three routes — `/api/file-mentions/check` (existence check),
`/api/file"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"-mentions/open` (system open, `mode: open/reveal`, per-platform command) and
`/api/file-mentions/con"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"fig` (whitelist read/write for the settings page). All three routes
are same-origin guarded. Probe s"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"urface: absolute/`~/` paths are checked only inside the session cwd or
user-declared whitelist roots"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" (stored via the official settings service — immediate
effect, no restart); whitelist roots are prot"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"ected against system disks and symlink
escapes. Pure Node stdlib; `execFile` avoids shell injection."},{"id":"p19s7","text":"
- **Client** (`lib/client.js`): a conversationEvents collector extracts paths from each
reply → pub"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"lishes them to turn data → the tail list filters non-existent paths before
rendering; inline clicks "},{"id":"p19s9","text":"use a **document-level click delegation** (the official render
entry is occupied by the official "de"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"liverables" plugin, so DOM delegation is the only
viable path); inline folder-icon buttons are inser"},{"id":"p19s11","text":"ted by a MutationObserver and restored
automatically after React re-renders; a settings card (sideba"},{"id":"p19s12","text":"r section + plugin page)
edits the whitelist. Scanning/decoration is **incremental**: the observer c"},{"id":"p19s13","text":"allback only
handles newly-added nodes inside the official message area (`[data-conversation-scroll]"},{"id":"p19s14","text":"`),
each new text is cheap-screened for path-like characters (no `/`, `~` or `\` → skipped
with zero"},{"id":"p19s15","text":" regex work and zero requests), and existence checks hit only the current
session — conversations wi"},{"id":"p19s16","text":"thout paths trigger no scanning at all; sidebars, hover cards,
menus and settings are never touched "},{"id":"p19s17","text":"s trigger no scanning at all; sidebars, hover cards,
menus and settings are never touched (v1.0.13)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"See docs/architecture.md."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Compatibility notes"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- Inline clicks rely on backtick-wrapped paths (the agent-output convention, same as
Codex); **bare "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"paths inside message text are clickable too** (decoration is
CSS-Highlight only, zero DOM mutation; "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"message area only — sidebars, hover cards,
menus and settings are never touched, v1.0.13).
- The off"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"icial "produced files" list and this plugin coexist: official wins when it has
output, otherwise thi"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"s plugin shows.
- Windows / Linux validation via issue or PR is welcome."}],"truncated":true}
